subject: POC kickoff: follow-the-sun hands-on sessions (Novus Health)
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@novushealth.com>, Tom Jeremy <tom.jeremy@novushealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: POC kickoff: follow-the-sun hands-on sessions (Novus Health)

Hi Elaine & Tom,

Great to be moving toward a hands-on POC with Novus Health — excited to get rolling. To make the kickoff useful for distributed teams, we propose a "follow-the-sun" approach for the technical deep dives: a single kickoff + recurring staggered working sessions that rotate times so US / EU / APAC engineers get in-session overlap at least once per week.

Proposed kickoff windows (pick one or suggest alternatives):
- Option A — Tue Feb 24, 10:00 PT / 18:00 UTC (US daytime + late EU overlap)
- Option B — Wed Feb 25, 15:00 UTC / 10:00 ET (EU/APAC overlap into US morning)
- Option C — Thu Feb 26, 00:30 UTC / 09:30 AEST (APAC-friendly, late EU)

Goals for kickoff:
- Review prompt sets and expected acceptance criteria (prompt_review)
- Routing architecture deep dive (latency & fallbacks)
- Load test plan & maintenance window coordination (non-prod)

Who should join from Novus: SRE lead, Platform/infra owner, one product owner. From Redwood: Vivek will lead the runtime/routing deep dive, Marissa will cover rollout/metrics, and I will run the prompt review and kickoff agenda.

I've attached a draft POC schedule (.ics) — please reply with preferred option and any hard constraints (e.g., maintenance windows). If none of the options work, give 2-3 time slots (in UTC) and we'll iterate.

Attachments: POC_Schedule_v2.ics (calendar stub)

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0187

From: Elaine Park <elaine@novushealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Tom Jeremy <tom.jeremy@novushealth.com>
Cc: SRE Team <sre-team@novushealth.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Feb 2026 11:07:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff: follow-the-sun hands-on sessions (Novus Health)

Thanks, Dylan — this looks promising. Tom and I reviewed the options with our SRE lead. Our preference is Option B (Wed Feb 25, 15:00 UTC). That time gives us a decent EU/APAC overlap and Tom can join from the product side.

One constraint from SRE: we need the load tests to run inside our non-production maintenance window, which is typically 02:00–06:00 UTC. If load testing is scheduled we should reserve that slot (we can do it the night after the kickoff if that helps).

Attendees we plan to have: Tom Jeremy (product), Akiko Sato (SRE lead), and myself (platform). Please confirm Redwood attendee list and any pre-reads you want us to review.

Attachment: attendee_list_novus.csv (simple roster)

Best,
Elaine Park
Director, Platform Engineering | Novus Health

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 22 Feb 2026 14:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff: follow-the-sun hands-on sessions (Novus Health)

Quick internal coordination — noted Novus prefers Wed 15:00 UTC and SRE wants load tests in 02:00–06:00 UTC. A few operational notes so we can confirm capacity:

- For meaningful load tests we should plan for 4 x p4d-equivalent instances (or the customer-provided equivalent) for 90 minutes to run sustained QPS and end-to-end routing checks.
- I can lead the routing deep dive and oversee the KV cache/latency instrumentation. Dylan — will you lead prompt review? Marissa, can you present observability/rollout plan? Ava, please confirm whether we can schedule a late-night test (02:00–06:00 UTC) on Redwood Dedicated test pool — if we need to reserve hardware I can open a ticket.
- I'll attach the load test plan draft for review. Please add any test scenarios you want (prompt permutations, tokenization edge cases, long-context runs).

Attachment: load_test_plan.pdf (12 pages, draft)

Thanks,
Vivek
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Quick data point for the load test scenarios: production-ish profile is ~120 requests/minute at peak, bursts to ~350 req/min for short periods, typical concurrent sessions ~12. We'd prefer the load test window be bumped 1 hour later to 03:00–07:00 UTC to accommodate a pre-test checklist on our side. Akiko (SRE) copied here — she'll coordinate final timing with you.

On Wed we'll focus on the prompt acceptance suite and a short routing fault-injection. See you then.
